Wrench order IS now the SUP-4378 consecutive block after all: ST% -> FP ST% -> FP WOH -> WOH, immediately together right after ST% (screenshot-confirmed against the live 'Configure Flow Type Metrics' column chooser). Original ticket text ('FP WOH before BOH U, WOH after FP WOH, NOT consecutive') is stale -- do not follow the old detail note above this one without checking JIRA first. Item 8 (Nested View / AssortmentAnalysisGrid) needs a parallel fp_sell_thru_pct_band composite-band block (weights 0.5/0.3/0.2 at ~:1614, band->color multiIf ~:1734) + an 'FP ST% Rating' column, and the existing ST% rating must be re-pointed to the agnostic sell_thru_pct. This is the largest single sub-task.

Only AssortmentFit.pivotdefn carries an FP raw-metric family today (BASE_SUM_FP_SALES_METRICS / BASE_SUM_FP_INV_METRICS params; FP achieved via a price-status-filtered re-sum of the normal wo_/omni_ columns aliased fp_*_x). AssortmentFitTYLY, AssortmentFitTYLYTranspose, AssortmentAggregateViewsNestedAttribute*, AssortmentAnalysisGrid have ZERO fp_ fields -- each needs the full parallel FP family built before FP ST%/FP WOH can be computed. This is the dominant implementation cost (items 4,5,8 = HIGH).

Assortment weekcount = max(count(distinct time)) -- plain, no strcntwk>0 condition and no prodlife filter (unlike Hindsighting). Rollup layers already use max(weekcount). So WOH needs no tot_weekcount_x plumbing: woh = avail_inv_u / (net_sls_u / weekcount) directly. avail_inv_u (= last_value_eoh_u + last_value_eoh_intransit_u + net_sls_u) already exists in AssortmentFit/TYLY/Transpose/AggViews/AnalysisGrid; NestedOverTime & NestedStyleOverTime use a lighter eoh_u base instead.

fix.approach: DECIDED 2026-09-08: modify the SALES base table IN PLACE (user's design, matches shipped SUP-4378 pattern in pivot/include/history_metrics_ty.ftl). NOT the separate-table approach. Mechanism: (a) comment out WHERE 'AND prodlife IN (${LEAF_PRODLIFE})'; (b) wrap every existing metric col in sumIf(<expr>, prodlife IN (${LEAF_PRODLIFE})) so filter-sensitive metrics still respect Price Status; (c) add agnostic cols in the same table as plain sum()/countIf -- tot_wo_shp_u_x, tot_omni_shp_u_x, tot_wo_ret_u_x, tot_omni_ret_u_x, tot_weekcount_x; (d) zero-fill those 5 in the other base param blocks; (e) thread through BASE_METRICS_UNION / _AGG_UNION / _AGG_UNION_SUM (sum, except max(tot_weekcount)); (f) COMPUTED_METRICS: tot_shp_u/tot_ret_u/tot_net_sls_u/tot_avail_inv_u(=ttl_eoh_u+tot_net_sls_u) then sell_thru_pct=tot_net_sls_u/tot_avail_inv_u, fp_sell_thru_pct=fp_net_sls_u/tot_avail_inv_u (shared agnostic denominator, matches SUP-4378), woh, fp_woh. reverseAggSQLs picks up ${COMPUTED_METRICS} automatically.
fix.assortmentfit_notes: AssortmentFit-specific: used ttl_eoh_u directly (last_value_eoh_u + last_value_eoh_intransit_u) instead of adding tot_last_value_eoh_u -- correct because AssortmentFit's BASE_LAST_INV_METRICS is already prodlife-unfiltered (pre-existing commented filter). Kept name fp_sell_thru_pct (Assortment wrench binds it; Hindsighting used fp_st_pct). Because BASE_SUM_SALES_METRICS was a params.X block (where ${LEAF_PRODLIFE} would NOT interpolate -- SUP-4378's HOCON lesson), the column list was inlined into the CREATE TABLE body and the now-dead params.BASE_SUM_SALES_METRICS block deleted.
